versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-fastmoss-mcp` skill for operating FastMoss MCP through the OOMOL `oo` CLI.
- Supports product, creator, shop, video, live, ad, agency, and market research workflows.
- Provides search, ranking, profile, trend, review, SKU, audience, and sales-performance analysis actions.
- Includes FastMoss detail URL helpers, document search, live tool discovery, and credit usage checks.
- Uses server-side OOMOL credentials so users can run FastMoss actions without handling raw tokens.
